description: This file defines an Angular component 'RecipeCardComponent' responsible for displaying a recipe card, including handling image fallback and navigation on click.

classes.name: RecipeCardComponent
classes.description: Angular component displaying recipe information, handling image fallback and routing to recipe details.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the image source, using the recipe's image URL or a fallback image.

methods.name: onImgError
methods.description: Handles the event when the image fails to load, setting a fallback image.

methods.name: onCardClick
methods.description: Handles click event on the card, routing to the detailed view of the recipe.
